description: Examples of new production-context filters for security alerts

has:deployment.description: Only show alerts affecting artifacts that have been deployed
has:deployment.use_case: Focus on vulnerabilities in running software, not just in repos

runtime-risk.description: Filter by the runtime risk level of deployed artifacts
runtime-risk.use_case: Prioritize fixes for high-risk deployments first

artifact-registry.description: Filter by registry where artifacts are stored
artifact-registry.use_case: Focus on artifacts in specific registries (e.g., production registries)

High severity alerts with >50% EPSS score in deployed artifacts
All deployed artifacts excluding low-risk deployments

security_campaigns.description: You can also use these filters when creating security campaigns
